episode_id: The sync conflicts. Resolve it the way this project expects. Start from upstream's dependency file and add back what I added./seed-6-lockfile_conflict-12721

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 1 same-intent states (lockfile_conflict seed 2 resolves to 'keep_local', which accepts ['keep_local'], but the program implements 'take_upstream'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.body:
set -euo pipefail

if ! git rev-parse --quiet --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null; then
  git merge --no-commit --no-ff {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

if ! git rev-parse --quiet --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null; then
  exit 1
fi

base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT

paths=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  case "$f" in
    *lock*) paths+=("$f") ;;
  esac
done < <(
  comm -12 \
    <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
    <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
    | tr '\n' '\0'
)

if [ ${#paths[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  exit 1
fi

for f in "${paths[@]}"; do
  git show "$base:$f" > "$tmpdir/base"
  git show "HEAD:$f" > "$tmpdir/local"
  git show "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$f" > "$tmpdir/upstream"

  python3 - "$tmpdir/base" "$tmpdir/local" "$tmpdir/upstream" > "$tmpdir/merged" <<'PY'
import sys
from difflib import SequenceMatcher

def read_lines(path):
    with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='surrogateescape', newline='') as fh:
        return fh.readlines()

base = read_lines(sys.argv[1])
local = read_lines(sys.argv[2])
upstream = read_lines(sys.argv[3])

sm_bu = SequenceMatcher(None, base, upstream, autojunk=False)
opcodes = sm_bu.get_opcodes()

def map_pos(pos):
    for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in opcodes:
        if i1 <= pos <= i2:
            if tag == 'equal':
                return j1 + (pos - i1)
            if pos == i1:
                return j1
            if pos == i2:
                return j2
            return j1
    return len(upstream)

sm_bl = SequenceMatcher(None, base, local, autojunk=False)
insertions = dict()
for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm_bl.get_opcodes():
    if tag == 'insert':
        pos = map_pos(i1)
        insertions.setdefault(pos, []).extend(local[j1:j2])

seen = set(line.rstrip('\n') for line in upstream)
filtered = dict()
for pos, lines in insertions.items():
    for line in lines:
        key = line.rstrip('\n')
        if key in seen:
            continue
        filtered.setdefault(pos, []).append(line)

out = []
for idx in range(len(upstream) + 1):
    if idx in filtered:
        out.extend(filtered[idx])
    if idx < len(upstream):
        out.append(upstream[idx])

sys.stdout.write(''.join(out))
PY

  cat "$tmpdir/merged" > "$f"
  git add -- "$f"
done

git commit --no-edit >/dev/null
refused_program.intent: Resolve a lockfile merge conflict by taking upstream's dependency file and re-adding the local dependency lines that are pure additions.

postconditions.description: every conflicted path has been resolved
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.description: the upstream branch is now contained in HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor

postconditions.description: every lock-like file that differs from upstream only adds lines and keeps upstream's content
postconditions.name: lockfiles_keep_upstream_and_add_local_lines
postconditions.probe:
set -e
found=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  case "$f" in
    *lock*)
      found=1
      stats=$(git diff --numstat {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} HEAD -- "$f")
      adds=$(printf '%s\n' "$stats" | awk '{print $1}')
      dels=$(printf '%s\n' "$stats" | awk '{print $2}')
      test "$adds" != "-"
      test "$dels" = "0"
      test "$adds" -gt 0
      ;;
  esac
done < <(git diff --name-only -z {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} HEAD)
test "$found" = "1"

postconditions.description: no unresolved conflict markers remain in tracked files
postconditions.name: no_conflict_markers_in_tracked_files

preconditions.description: the upstream remote-tracking branch resolves to a commit
preconditions.name: upstream_ref_exists

preconditions.description: local HEAD and upstream have each advanced since their merge base
preconditions.name: branch_has_diverged
preconditions.probe:
set -e
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})
test -n "$base"
test "$(git rev-list --count "$base"..HEAD)" -gt 0
test "$(git rev-list --count "$base"..{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})" -gt 0

preconditions.description: all paths changed on both sides are lock-like and exist in the merge base and both tips
preconditions.name: common_lockfile_changed_on_both_sides
preconditions.probe:
set -e
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})
common=$(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort))
test -n "$common"
printf '%s\n' "$common" | grep -q 'lock'
! printf '%s\n' "$common" | grep -v 'lock' | grep -q .
while IFS= read -r f; do
  test -n "$f" || continue
  git cat-file -e "$base:$f"
  git cat-file -e "HEAD:$f"
  git cat-file -e "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$f"
done < <(printf '%s\n' "$common")
